review_response_tasks.stem: Bert is ____ blue paint for the wooden sign. (mix / mixing)
review_response_tasks.rationale: mix：is后需现在分词，mix原形不能直接组成此进行结构。；mixing：is mixing构成现在进行时。

review_response_tasks.stem: Maya hopes to ____ a small frame before lunch. (make / makes)
review_response_tasks.rationale: make：to后用动词原形make。；makes：不定式标记to后不能用第三人称单数makes。

review_response_tasks.stem: Yesterday I ____ how to clean the brushes. (learned / learnt)
review_response_tasks.rationale: learned：learn的过去式，昨日语境成立。；learnt：Oxford同列learn的过去式learnt；与learned同等接受。

review_response_tasks.stem: My sister did not ____ a ruler to the workshop. (bring / brought)
review_response_tasks.rationale: bring：did not后接原形bring。；brought：did not后不能使用过去式brought。

review_response_tasks.stem: The empty shelf is ____ to hold the long frame. (wide enough / enough wide)
review_response_tasks.rationale: wide enough：enough修饰形容词放其后。；enough wide：enough不能在这里置于形容词wide前。

review_response_tasks.stem: We left the wet brushes ____ a jar of water. (in / at)
review_response_tasks.rationale: in：水罐内部用in a jar。；at：at不表达题中刷子置于水罐内的位置。

review_response_tasks.stem: This is Nia's drawing. Please return it to ____. (her / she)
review_response_tasks.rationale: her：介词to后用人称代词宾格her。；she：she是主格，不能直接作介词to的宾语。

review_response_tasks.stem: The two helpers ____ the table when I arrived. (were cleaning / cleans)
review_response_tasks.rationale: were cleaning：复数主语与were cleaning一致，过去到达语境成立。；cleans：cleans既为现在时又是第三人称单数，不与复数主语一致。

review_response_tasks.stem: Thank you for ____ the broken hinge. (mending / mend)
review_response_tasks.rationale: mending：for后动词用-ing形式。；mend：for后不能直接接动词原形mend作此补语。

review_response_tasks.stem: Please close the paint box ____. (careful / carefully)
review_response_tasks.rationale: careful：careful为形容词，不能在此修饰close。；carefully：carefully为副词，修饰关盒动作。
